s0301.literal: Envoys were dispatched to inspect and verify garrison troops of each branch secretariat.
s0301.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to inspect and verify garrison troops of each branch secretariat.

s0302.literal: On jihai day capital officials' salary notes were calculated, with three-tenths paid in grain.
s0302.idiomatic: On jihai day capital officials' salary notes were calculated, with three-tenths paid in grain.

s0303.literal: On guimao day Mars transgressed Wall Formation.
s0303.idiomatic: On guimao day Mars transgressed Wall Formation.

s0304.literal: On jiachen day Temüder said: "The market-purchase weaving and coinage are poor in quality because those in charge of the business are negligent; I request the dismissal of right vice chancellor Gao Fang and others from office, and that prefectures and counties be ordered to remake them, collecting the original cost.
s0304.idiomatic: On jiachen day Temüder said, "The market-purchase weaving and coinage are poor in quality because those in charge of the business are negligent; I request the dismissal of right vice chancellor Gao Fang and others from office, and that prefectures and counties be ordered to remake them, collecting the original cost.

s0306.literal: The Grand Ceremonies Bureau drafted and submitted the ritual for seasonal offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0306.idiomatic: The Grand Ceremonies Bureau drafted and submitted the ritual for seasonal offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0307.literal: Twelfth month, on yisi new moon, an edict stated: "We reverently carry forward the counsels left by our forebears and have succeeded to the great inheritance; mindful how heavy is the charge entrusted to us, we dare not forget to continue and fulfill it.
s0307.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on yisi new moon, an edict stated, "We reverently carry forward the counsels left by our forebears and have succeeded to the great inheritance; mindful how heavy is the charge entrusted to us, we dare not forget to continue and fulfill it.

s0308.literal: Therefore on Bingzi of the eleventh month of YanYou seventh year, arrayed in ceremonial robes and cap, we reverently offered thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0308.idiomatic: Therefore on Bingzi of the eleventh month of YanYou seventh year, arrayed in ceremonial robes and cap, we reverently offered thanks at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0309.literal: Now that the great rite has been completed, universal rejoicing throughout the realm is fitting.
s0309.idiomatic: Now that the great rite has been completed, universal rejoicing throughout the realm is fitting.

s0310.literal: As a full year has now passed, we change the reign era to guide Heaven and Earth's supreme harmony and follow the Spring and Autumn Annals' scrupulous beginning — let next year be the first year of Zhizhi.
s0310.idiomatic: As a full year has now passed, we change the reign era to guide Heaven and Earth's supreme harmony and follow the Spring and Autumn Annals' scrupulous beginning — let next year be the first year of Zhizhi.

s0311.literal: Reduce land rent and taxes throughout the realm by two-tenths, and tax-in-kind silver by five-tenths.
s0311.idiomatic: Reduce land rent and taxes throughout the realm by two-tenths, and tax-in-kind silver by five-tenths.

s0312.literal: Remit miscellaneous taxes for three years in the three routes of Dadu, Shangdu, and Xinghe.
s0312.idiomatic: Remit miscellaneous taxes for 3 years in the 3 routes of Dadu, Shangdu, and Xinghe.

s0313.literal: Grant preferential remission for two years to salt-boiling, iron-smelting, and similar households.
s0313.idiomatic: Grant preferential remission for 2 years to salt-boiling, iron-smelting, and similar households.

s0314.literal: Lift prohibitions on lakes and marshes in Yan South and Shandong, allowing the people to gather produce.
s0314.idiomatic: Lift prohibitions on lakes and marshes in Yan South and Shandong, allowing the people to gather produce.

s0315.literal: Order that officials' family members stranded in distant border regions be provided travel funds by the relevant offices and sent home;
s0315.idiomatic: Order that officials' family members stranded in distant border regions be provided travel funds by the relevant offices and sent home;

s0316.literal: those whose sons and daughters had been pawned or sold to others were permitted to return to their families.
s0316.idiomatic: Those whose sons and daughters had been pawned or sold to others were permitted to return to their families.

s0317.literal: Supervising censors and surveillance commissions shall each year recommend two persons fit to serve as prefects or magistrates.
s0317.idiomatic: Supervising censors and surveillance commissions shall each year recommend 2 persons fit to serve as prefects or magistrates.

s0318.literal: Officials of seventh rank and above who have bold plans and long-reaching policies that can benefit the age and bring peace to the people shall submit them sealed intact.
s0318.idiomatic: Officials of seventh rank and above who have bold plans and long-reaching policies that can benefit the age and bring peace to the people shall submit them sealed intact.

s0319.literal: Scholars who live in retirement practicing integrity, understand governmental principles, and seek no renown shall have full particulars reported by the relevant offices.
s0319.idiomatic: Scholars who live in retirement practicing integrity, understand governmental principles, and seek no renown shall have full particulars reported by the relevant offices.

s0320.literal: " On dingwei day the Yao barbarians of Bozhou, Deyanglong and others, came to submit.
s0320.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Yao barbarians of Bozhou, Deyanglong and others, came to submit.

s0321.literal: On gengxu day copper was cast into a Buddhist image and placed in the Jade Virtue Hall.
s0321.idiomatic: On gengxu day copper was cast into a Buddhist image and placed in the Jade Virtue Hall.

s0322.literal: On renzi day Princess Shouning was granted seventy-five thousand ingots of notes.
s0322.idiomatic: On renzi day Princess Shouning was granted 75,000 ingots of notes.

s0323.literal: On guichou day, on account of the Heavenly Longevity Festival, envoys were dispatched in advance to perform Daoist rites at Longhu Mountain.
s0323.idiomatic: On guichou day, on account of the Heavenly Longevity Festival, envoys were dispatched in advance to perform Daoist rites at Longhu Mountain.

s0324.literal: On yimao day, leading all officials, the jade book and jade seal were presented, adding to the Grand Empress Dowager the honorific title Grand Empress Dowager Yitian Xingsheng Ciren Zhaoyi Shouyuan Quande Taining Fuqing Huiwen Chongyou.
s0324.idiomatic: On yimao day, leading all officials, the jade book and jade seal were presented, adding to the Grand Empress Dowager the honorific title Grand Empress Dowager Yitian Xingsheng Ciren Zhaoyi Shouyuan Quande Taining Fuqing Huiwen Chongyou.

s0325.literal: Hanlin academician Qotlughdurumishi presented in translation Song Confucian Zhen Dexiu's Extension of the Great Learning; the Emperor said: "For self-cultivation and governing the state, nothing surpasses this book.
s0325.idiomatic: Hanlin academician Qotlughdurumishi presented in translation Song Confucian Zhen Dexiu's Extension of the Great Learning; the Emperor said, "For self-cultivation and governing the state, nothing surpasses this book.

s0326.literal: " Fifty thousand ingots of notes were granted.

s0327.literal: Henan suffered famine; the Emperor asked the reason, and the assembled ministers could not answer; the Emperor said: "Truly it is because our Way of governance has not yet reached full harmony, you likewise have not fully devoted yourselves to your duties, and appointments have missed the right men, causing yin and yang to fall out of harmony and disasters to arrive one after another.
s0327.idiomatic: Henan suffered famine; the Emperor asked the reason, and the assembled ministers could not answer; the Emperor said, "Truly it is because our Way of governance has not yet reached full harmony, you likewise have not fully devoted yourselves to your duties, and appointments have missed the right men, causing yin and yang to fall out of harmony and disasters to arrive one after another.

s0328.literal: From now on each must strive to be diligent and reverent to respond to Heaven's intent, and must not let our people suffer yet heavier distress.
s0328.idiomatic: From now on each must strive to be diligent and reverent to respond to Heaven's intent, and must not let our people suffer yet heavier distress.

s0330.literal: On bingchen day, because the ceremony of adding to the Grand Empress Dowager's honorific title was completed, the Emperor took Great Brightness Hall and received court congratulations.
s0330.idiomatic: On bingchen day, because the ceremony of adding to the Grand Empress Dowager's honorific title was completed, the Emperor took Great Brightness Hall and received court congratulations.

s0331.literal: On dingsi day an edict was proclaimed to the court and the realm.
s0331.idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict was proclaimed to the court and the realm.

s0332.literal: On wuwu day the moon transgressed Well.
s0332.idiomatic: On wuwu day the moon transgressed Well.

s0333.literal: On gengshen day the moon transgressed Ghost.
s0333.idiomatic: On gengshen day the moon transgressed Ghost.

s0334.literal: On xinyou day the rear hall of Extended Spring Pavilion was constructed.
s0334.idiomatic: On xinyou day the rear hall of Extended Spring Pavilion was constructed.

s0335.literal: On renxu day the Western monk Rinchen Qarshi was summoned to the capital; an edict directed the prefectures and counties he passed through to receive him with solemn ceremony.
s0335.idiomatic: On renxu day the Western monk Rinchen Qarshi was summoned to the capital; an edict directed the prefectures and counties he passed through to receive him with solemn ceremony.

s0336.literal: On yichou day a comet was observed for forty day-and-night cycles at the Muslim Directorate of Astronomy.
s0336.idiomatic: On yichou day a comet was observed for 40 day-and-night cycles at the Muslim Directorate of Astronomy.

s0337.literal: On bingyin day Kuochebo, commissioner of the Registry of Auspicious Objects, was made privy council director.
s0337.idiomatic: On bingyin day Kuochebo, commissioner of the Registry of Auspicious Objects, was made privy council director.

s0338.literal: Secret Buddhist rites were performed at Extended Spring Pavilion.
s0338.idiomatic: Secret Buddhist rites were performed at Extended Spring Pavilion.

s0339.literal: On dingmao day Temüder and Baizhu said: "Recently an edict directed the court and the realm to speak of gains and losses; now those submitting sealed memorials sometimes go directly to the imperial presence.
s0339.idiomatic: On dingmao day Temüder and Baizhu said, "Recently an edict directed the court and the realm to speak of gains and losses; now those submitting sealed memorials sometimes go directly to the imperial presence.

s0340.literal: We beg that we be permitted to open and examine them first, and then enter and memorialize."
s0340.idiomatic: We beg that we be permitted to open and examine them first, and then enter and memorialize."

s0341.literal: The Emperor said: "Those who speak on affairs of state may come directly before Us; as for common people who casually lodge lawsuits, that is to be forbidden.
s0341.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Those who speak on affairs of state may come directly before Us; as for common people who casually lodge lawsuits, that is to be forbidden.

s0342.literal: " Seven hundred fifty thousand ingots of notes were granted to the empress of Wuzong.
s0342.idiomatic: 750,000 ingots of notes were granted to the empress of Wuzong.

s0343.literal: Printed copies of Extension of the Great Learning were distributed and bestowed on all ministers.
s0343.idiomatic: Printed copies of Extension of the Great Learning were distributed and bestowed on all ministers.

s0344.literal: On wuchen day, because the ceremony adding to the Grand Empress Dowager's honorific title was completed, announcement was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0344.idiomatic: On wuchen day, because the ceremony adding to the Grand Empress Dowager's honorific title was completed, announcement was made at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0345.literal: On jisi day an edict abolished the Buddha-welcoming rite of the eighth day of the second month next year.
s0345.idiomatic: On jisi day an edict abolished the Buddha-welcoming rite of the eighth day of the second month next year.

s0346.literal: Central secretariat right vice chancellor Mubalagha was dismissed and made Jiangxi branch secretariat right vice chancellor; central secretariat associate administrator Jirihang was made right vice chancellor; Jiangnan and western Zhejiang surveillance commissioner Xue Chujing was made central secretariat associate administrator.
s0346.idiomatic: Central secretariat right vice chancellor Mubalagha was dismissed and made Jiangxi branch secretariat right vice chancellor; central secretariat associate administrator Jirihang was made right vice chancellor; Jiangnan and western Zhejiang surveillance commissioner Xue Chujing was made central secretariat associate administrator.

s0347.literal: Envoys were dispatched to inspect the military supplies storehouse of Fengyuan Route.
s0347.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to inspect the military supplies storehouse of Fengyuan Route.

s0348.literal: On xinwei day Baizhu submitted diagrams of the imperial escort insignia; the Emperor held that the Tang system used twelve thousand three hundred men and wasted resources, and therefore fixed the grand escort at three thousand two hundred men and the statutory escort at two thousand five hundred men.
s0348.idiomatic: On xinwei day Baizhu submitted diagrams of the imperial escort insignia; the Emperor held that the Tang system used 12,300 men and wasted resources, and therefore fixed the grand escort at 3,200 men and the statutory escort at 2,500 men.

s0349.literal: The Yao of Shangsi Prefecture joined with Annam to raid Zhong Prefecture.
s0349.idiomatic: The Yao of Shangsi Prefecture joined with Annam to raid Zhong Prefecture.

s0350.literal: On guiyou day the Emperor heard that He Bayan's mother was old and took pity; the seized Jingzhao fields and water mills were returned to his family.
s0350.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Emperor heard that He Bayan's mother was old and took pity; the seized Jingzhao fields and water mills were returned to his family.

s0351.literal: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Bayanchar and Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor Baisadu were both dismissed from office on conviction of corruption.
s0351.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Bayanchar and Jiangxi branch secretariat grand councillor Baisadu were both dismissed from office on conviction of corruption.

s0352.literal: That year, seven thousand six hundred thirty cases of lighter and heavier criminal judgment were decided.
s0352.idiomatic: That year, 7,630 cases of lighter and heavier criminal judgment were decided.

s0353.literal: The Yellow River breached at Yuanwu, Bianliang, inundating various counties;
s0353.idiomatic: The Yellow River breached at Yuanwu, Bianliang, inundating various counties;

s0354.literal: the Hutuo breached at Wen'an, Dacheng, and other counties;
s0354.idiomatic: The Hutuo breached at Wen'an, Dacheng, and other counties;

s0355.literal: the Hun River overflowed, destroying people's fields and dwellings.
s0355.idiomatic: The Hun River overflowed, destroying people's fields and dwellings.

s0356.literal: In Chengji County, Qin Prefecture, violent rain caused mountains to collapse, rotten and ruined tombs to rise up, and livestock and property to be buried.
s0356.idiomatic: In Chengji County, Qin Prefecture, violent rain caused mountains to collapse, rotten and ruined tombs to rise up, and livestock and property to be buried.

s0357.literal: In Yanjin County, Bianliang, a great wind darkened the day; many mulberry trees were damaged.
s0357.idiomatic: In Yanjin County, Bianliang, a great wind darkened the day; many mulberry trees were damaged.

s0358.literal: In Datong there was hail; the largest were like chicken eggs.
s0358.idiomatic: In Datong there was hail; the largest were like chicken eggs.

s0359.literal: Garrison-farm fields of the various guards were harmed by frost; in Yijin County black frost fell with rain.
s0359.idiomatic: Garrison-farm fields of the various guards were harmed by frost; in Yijin County black frost fell with rain.

s0360.literal: Zhizhi first year, spring, first month, on dingchou day Buddhist rites were performed at Wende Hall.
s0360.idiomatic: Zhizhi first year, spring, first month, on dingchou day Buddhist rites were performed at Wende Hall.

s0361.literal: On renwu day one post each of associate commissioner and transport judge was added to the Huozhou Capital Grain Transport Commission.
s0361.idiomatic: On renwu day 1 post each of associate commissioner and transport judge was added to the Huozhou Capital Grain Transport Commission.

s0362.literal: On jiashen day King Wang Jang of Goryeo was summoned to Shangdu.
s0362.idiomatic: On jiashen day King Wang Jang of Goryeo was summoned to Shangdu.

s0363.literal: On bingxu day the Emperor, clad in ceremonial robes and cap, offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; left chancellor Baizhu served as secondary presenter and privy council director Kuochebo as final presenter.
s0363.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Emperor, clad in ceremonial robes and cap, offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; left chancellor Baizhu served as secondary presenter and privy council director Kuochebo as final presenter.

s0364.literal: An edict to the assembled ministers stated: "In a year there are only four sacrifices; to have others perform them in Our stead cannot produce the sincerity of being present in person — truly We cannot be at ease with this.
s0364.idiomatic: An edict to the assembled ministers stated, "In a year there are only four sacrifices; to have others perform them in Our stead cannot produce the sincerity of being present in person — truly We cannot be at ease with this.

s0365.literal: Each year We shall personally sacrifice, for the remainder of Our life.
s0365.idiomatic: Each year We shall personally sacrifice, for the remainder of Our life.

s0366.literal: " Court ministers spoke saying that when the sacrificial rites were completed the realm should be amnestied; the Emperor instructed them: "Favor may be regularly bestowed, but amnesties must not be frequently issued.
s0366.idiomatic: Court ministers spoke saying that when the sacrificial rites were completed the realm should be amnestied; the Emperor instructed them, "Favor may be regularly bestowed, but amnesties must not be frequently issued.

s0367.literal: If murderers obtain release, what wrong have the dead committed?"
s0367.idiomatic: If murderers obtain release, what wrong have the dead committed?"

s0368.literal: An order directed the central secretariat to present matters of convenience and carry them out.
s0368.idiomatic: An order directed the central secretariat to present matters of convenience and carry them out.

s0369.literal: On dinghai day the Emperor wished to hang lanterns in the palace on Lantern Festival; associate deliberator of central secretariat affairs Zhang Yanghao submitted a memorial advising against it; the Emperor immediately ordered it cancelled and said: "With ministers such as this, what need have We to worry?
s0369.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Emperor wished to hang lanterns in the palace on Lantern Festival; associate deliberator of central secretariat affairs Zhang Yanghao submitted a memorial advising against it; the Emperor immediately ordered it cancelled and said, "With ministers such as this, what need have We to worry?

s0370.literal: From now on, whenever We have faults, it is not only censorate officials who should remonstrate — anyone may speak.
s0370.idiomatic: From now on, whenever We have faults, it is not only censorate officials who should remonstrate — anyone may speak.

s0371.literal: " Two bolts of silk were bestowed on Yanghao.
s0371.idiomatic: 2 bolts of silk were bestowed on Yanghao.

s0373.literal: On guisi day the following of Prince Olus was famine-stricken; grain from the Jingzhou and Pingdi storehouses was issued in relief.
s0373.idiomatic: On guisi day the following of Prince Olus was famine-stricken; grain from the Jingzhou and Pingdi storehouses was issued in relief.

s0374.literal: Qishui County, Qi Prefecture, suffered famine; grain was issued in relief for three months.
s0374.idiomatic: Qishui County, Qi Prefecture, suffered famine; grain was issued in relief for 3 months.

s0375.literal: Fengyuan Route suffered famine; wine was banned.
s0375.idiomatic: Fengyuan Route suffered famine; wine was banned.

s0376.literal: On yiwei day the moon masked Room.
s0376.idiomatic: On yiwei day the moon masked Room.

s0377.literal: On jihai day the Yanfu Superintendency was reduced to the Yanfu Intendant Office and the Guangfu Superintendency to the Guangfu Intendant Office, rank 5b.
s0377.idiomatic: On jihai day the Yanfu Superintendency was reduced to the Yanfu Intendant Office and the Guangfu Superintendency to the Guangfu Intendant Office, rank 5b.

s0378.literal: Because a Buddhist temple was being built at Shou'an Mountain, a treasury was established to manage funds and goods, rank 7b.
s0378.idiomatic: Because a Buddhist temple was being built at Shou'an Mountain, a treasury was established to manage funds and goods, rank 7b.

s0379.literal: On jiachen day Mercury transgressed Outer Screen.
s0379.idiomatic: On jiachen day Mercury transgressed Outer Screen.

s0380.literal: Mercury, Venus, Mars, and Saturn — four planets — gathered at Kui.
s0380.idiomatic: Mercury, Venus, Mars, and Saturn — 4 planets — gathered at Kui.

s0381.literal: Second month, Bianliang and Guide suffered famine; one hundred thousand shi of grain was issued for relief sale.
s0381.idiomatic: Second month, Bianliang and Guide suffered famine; 100,000 shi of grain was issued for relief sale.

s0382.literal: Henan and Anfeng suffered famine; twenty-five thousand ingots of notes and fifty thousand shi of grain were issued in relief.
s0382.idiomatic: Henan and Anfeng suffered famine; 25,000 ingots of notes and 50,000 shi of grain were issued in relief.

s0383.literal: On wushen day sacrifice was offered to the altars of soil and grain.
s0383.idiomatic: On wushen day sacrifice was offered to the altars of soil and grain.

s0384.literal: Central Capital Weiguard was renamed Loyal Support Personal Guard Army Command.
s0384.idiomatic: Central Capital Weiguard was renamed Loyal Support Personal Guard Army Command.

s0385.literal: On jiyou day an imperial spirit hall for Renzong was built at Pujing Temple.
s0385.idiomatic: On jiyou day an imperial spirit hall for Renzong was built at Pujing Temple.

s0386.literal: On xinhai day three thousand five hundred troops were deployed to repair the Huayan Temple at Shangdu.
s0386.idiomatic: On xinhai day 3,500 troops were deployed to repair the Huayan Temple at Shangdu.

s0387.literal: At night on renzi day Venus, Mars, and Saturn — three stars — gathered at Kui.
s0387.idiomatic: At night on renzi day Venus, Mars, and Saturn — 3 stars — gathered at Kui.

s0388.literal: Great Yongfu Temple was completed; five hundred taels of gold, two thousand five hundred taels of silver, five hundred thousand ingots of notes, and ten thousand bolts of silks and cloths were granted.
s0388.idiomatic: Great Yongfu Temple was completed; 500 taels of gold, 2,500 taels of silver, 500,000 ingots of notes, and 10,000 bolts of silks and cloths were granted.

s0389.literal: On dingsi day the Emperor hunted at Willow Grove; an edict directed reconstruction of the traveling palace.
s0389.idiomatic: On dingsi day the Emperor hunted at Willow Grove; an edict directed reconstruction of the traveling palace.

s0390.literal: Supervising censors Guanyinbao, Soqar Qadirmishi, Cheng Gui, and Li Qianheng remonstrated against building the Buddhist temple at Shou'an Mountain; Guanyinbao and Soqar Qadirmishi were executed, Cheng Gui and Li Qianheng were beaten with the staff and banished to the Nurgan region.
s0390.idiomatic: Supervising censors Guanyinbao, Soqar Qadirmishi, Cheng Gui, and Li Qianheng remonstrated against building the Buddhist temple at Shou'an Mountain; Guanyinbao and Soqar Qadirmishi were executed, Cheng Gui and Li Qianheng were beaten with the staff and banished to the Nurgan region.

s0391.literal: On jiwei day privy council officials requested granting deputy director Wu Yuangui the title Grand Master for Splendid Happiness; because the rank was too high it was not approved; Grand Master for Correct Service was granted instead.
s0391.idiomatic: On jiwei day privy council officials requested granting deputy director Wu Yuangui the title Grand Master for Splendid Happiness; because the rank was too high it was not approved; Grand Master for Correct Service was granted instead.

s0392.literal: Impoverished households of thirty-one post stations on the Molin route were relieved with grain.
s0392.idiomatic: Impoverished households of 31 post stations on the Molin route were relieved with grain.

s0393.literal: On xinyou day Venus transgressed Mars.
s0393.idiomatic: On xinyou day Venus transgressed Mars.

s0394.literal: On guihai day the moon transgressed Heart.
s0394.idiomatic: On guihai day the moon transgressed Heart.

s0395.literal: On jiazi day Chenghui Temple was established, rank 3a; forty thousand households of Changzhou and Yixing were detached and placed under it.
s0395.idiomatic: On jiazi day Chenghui Temple was established, rank 3a; 40,000 households of Changzhou and Yixing were detached and placed under it.

s0396.literal: On dingmao day the monk Fahong was made patriarch of the Buddhist Origin lineage and granted Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and Defender of the State.
s0396.idiomatic: On dingmao day the monk Fahong was made patriarch of the Buddhist Origin lineage and granted Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and Defender of the State.

s0397.literal: Appeals bypassing the censorate and secretariat were forbidden; illicit appointments by transmitted edict from the previous reign were abolished.
s0397.idiomatic: Appeals bypassing the censorate and secretariat were forbidden; illicit appointments by transmitted edict from the previous reign were abolished.

s0398.literal: On wuchen day seven hundred fifty thousand ingots of notes were granted to the attendants of Princess Jaya Bala.
s0398.idiomatic: On wuchen day 750,000 ingots of notes were granted to the attendants of Princess Jaya Bala.

s0399.literal: Third month, on jiaxu day Prince of Ying Yeshi Temür's following suffered losses in livestock; five hundred thousand ingots of notes were granted.
s0399.idiomatic: Third month, on jiaxu day Prince of Ying Yeshi Temür's following suffered losses in livestock; 500,000 ingots of notes were granted.

s0400.literal: On bingzi day a temple to Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa was built in the capital.
s0400.idiomatic: On bingzi day a temple to Imperial Preceptor 'Phags-pa was built in the capital.
